mechanism: Both drugs can reduce intraocular pressure through different mechanisms; combined use may potentiate hypotensive and CNS effects, with clonidine's alpha-2 agonism potentially enhancing dorzolamide's carbonic anhydrase inhibition effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; assess for excessive IOP reduction and CNS depression; ensure adequate dosing intervals and consider alternative agents if additive hypotensive effects become problematic.
